## Mocha's yargs usage and the v17 upgrade

**The upgrade request.** There was a tracked issue to move Mocha off yargs 16.x, primarily driven by a security advisory. The dependency chain was mocha → yargs@16.2.0 → cliui@7.0.4 → strip-ansi@6.0.0 → ansi-regex@5.0.0, and the note was that yargs 17.6.0 contained a more up-to-date version without the issue. The motivation stemmed from an npm audit flagging ansi-regex 5.0.0 as high severity — an inefficient regular expression complexity issue in chalk/ansi-regex.
